train.selection_rule: Select direct body/div/div divisions of the specified subtype and numbers, in original document order; collect their paragraphs in document order. Omit note/head/foreign/rdg/del/num subtrees, including paragraphs inside them. For choice select first expan, else first reg, else first child; for app select only its first direct lem and fail if absent. Keep outer tails but discard unselected alternative branches and their internal tails. Join paragraphs with a newline; do not normalise letters, case, punctuation or within-paragraph whitespace.
